pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Hardens the production Timeline runtime contract. Multi-player composition uses explicit priority with deterministic tie-breaks and diagnostics; Timeline events retain stable asset + semantic document identity; continuous Animation sampling no longer fabricates seek discontinuities; production VFX can be driven by the Timeline external clock; neutral loop semantics are exposed through the runtime; and unsaved Editor working copies can compile through the same runtime path.

The PR remains Draft while Project Rust, Sequencer, and final validation continue.
